near_lines: Close... the site's one grid over, I can see it from here.
Almost. It's right next to me, wrong square.
wrong_lines: Nothing here, Ground. That walk cost me air.
Negative. Wrong spot. Check the map again?
I'm standing on bare regolith. Where now?
bad_lines: Sparks! That wasn't the right step.
Whoa — that tripped something. Not that one.

templates.title: Photo survey
brief: Ground, Science wants a photo survey {dist} {dir} of the {landmark}. Which grid?
Next stop: survey panorama {dist} {dir} of the {landmark}. Point me there?
success_lines: Panorama done. Pretty out here, Ground.
fail_lines: I'm calling it, Ground. We'll try the survey another night.

card.title: Survey #{n}
card.text: Panorama taken {dist} {dir} of the {landmark}. Nothing unusual.

templates.title: Core sample
brief: Geology wants a core {dist} {dir} of the {landmark}. Where do I go?
Sample request: {dist} {dir} of the {landmark}. Your call, Ground.
fail_lines: Too much walking, Ground. I'm heading home.

card.title: Core #{n}
card.text: Core taken {dist} {dir} of the {landmark}. Ordinary mare basalt.

templates.title: Instrument check
brief: The heat-flow probe {dist} {dir} of the {landmark} stopped reporting. Guide me to it?
success_lines: Found it. Cable was just loose. It's talking again.
fail_lines: Can't find the probe. Let's leave it for daylight.

templates.title: Rover power coupling
templates.brief: Ground, the rover's power coupling keeps dropping out. Got the manual handy? Talk me through it.
steps: Set rover master switch to OFF
Brush the dust off the pins
Set rover master switch to ON
fail_lines: It's fried, Ground. Rover's off until someone fixes it properly.

templates.title: High-gain antenna drive
templates.brief: Your voice keeps cutting out — the high-gain antenna is drifting. Walk me through the realignment?
steps: Switch comms to the omni antenna
Rotate the dish to azimuth mark 214
distractors: Rotate the dish to azimuth mark 241
fail_lines: It's going to keep drifting. We'll live with it.

templates.title: CO2 scrubber cartridge
templates.brief: CO2 alarm in the habitat. I need to swap the scrubber cartridge — read me the procedure?
steps: Seat the new cartridge, arrow up
distractors: Seat the new cartridge, arrow down
Vent the cabin to purge CO2
success_lines: CO2 dropping. I can breathe easy. Literally.
fail_lines: I'll keep the old cartridge running. Not ideal.

templates.title: Core sample — Site Alpha
templates.brief: Site Alpha is the big shadowed boulder two grids north of the Boulder Field. Which grid, Ground?
success_lines: I'm at Site Alpha. Big boulder, deep shadow. Setting up the corer.
fail_lines: Found it on my own. Cost me some air, though.

templates.title: Geophone array
templates.brief: Ruth wants the geophones three grids west of Site Alpha, out on the flat. Guide me in?
success_lines: Geophones are down. Listening... oh. Ground, are you getting this?
fail_lines: I put them down somewhere close enough. Listening...

templates.title: The glint
templates.brief: The glint was one grid east of Rille Bend, down in the channel. Talk me down?
success_lines: I'm in the channel. Ground... I see it.
fail_lines: Found the way down myself. Ground... I see it.

templates.title: Unit 00 access panel
templates.brief: It's in our own manual index, Ground. 'Unit 00'. Read me the procedure. Slowly.
steps: Brush the dust off the access panel
Lift the panel by the lower edge
distractors: Pry the panel open with the hammer
success_lines: Panel's open. Something inside just... started turning.
fail_lines: I forced it. It's open. Something inside is turning.
